sentences.text: Rudi berseru memanggil rekannya ketika pencuri itu kabur lewat pintu belakang.

sentences.text: Rudi menjaga unjuk rasa mahasiswa agar berjalan damai.
sentences.en: Rudi kept watch over the student demonstration so it would stay peaceful.
sentences.ko: 루디는 대학생 시위가 평화롭게 진행되도록 지켰어요.

sentences.text: Rina ikut unjuk rasa damai menentang perdagangan satwa liar.
sentences.en: Rina joined a peaceful demonstration against the wildlife trade.
sentences.ko: 리나는 야생동물 거래에 반대하는 평화 시위에 참여했어요.

sentences.text: Rudi bermimpi semua warga di kampung halaman hidup sejahtera.
sentences.en: Rudi dreams that everyone in his home village will live in prosperity.
sentences.ko: 루디는 고향 마을 사람들이 모두 넉넉하게 사는 날을 꿈꿔요.

sentences.text: Rina ingin semua hewan di penampungan hidup sejahtera.
sentences.en: Rina wants all the animals in the shelter to live well.
sentences.ko: 리나는 보호소의 모든 동물이 잘 지내기를 바라요.

sentences.text: Berkas kasus itu sudah Rudi serahkan ke lembaga peradilan.
sentences.en: Rudi has already handed the case file over to the judiciary.
sentences.ko: 루디는 그 사건 서류를 이미 사법 기관에 넘겼어요.

sentences.text: Kasus penyiksaan hewan itu dibawa ke peradilan, dan Rina menjadi saksi ahli.
sentences.en: The animal cruelty case was taken to court, and Rina served as an expert witness.
sentences.ko: 그 동물 학대 사건은 재판에 넘겨졌고 리나가 전문가 증인으로 나섰어요.

sentences.text: Rudi tetap tenang meski menerima hinaan dari pengendara yang ditilang.
sentences.en: Rudi stayed calm even when a ticketed driver hurled insults at him.
sentences.ko: 루디는 딱지를 뗀 운전자에게 모욕을 당해도 침착했어요.

sentences.text: Rina tidak peduli pada hinaan orang yang menganggap merawat kucing liar itu membuang waktu.
sentences.en: Rina ignores the insults of people who think caring for stray cats is a waste of time.
sentences.ko: 리나는 길고양이를 돌보는 게 시간 낭비라는 사람들의 비난을 신경 쓰지 않아요.
